metadata.host_isolation: shared developer machine; no CPU pinning or thermal isolation
metadata.aggregation: median of the three per-run medians; min/max are ranges, not confidence intervals
metadata.wire_scope: one SpanContent::Heads envelope; TreeSpec and outer request excluded
metadata.endpoint: decode and visit/hash every key, ID and normalized clock tip; output drop included
metadata.allocation_scope: decode+visit only; fixture and existing wire buffer excluded; retained modes include one wire-buffer copy
